about_the_game:
TwinGrip is a twin-stick physics-based puzzle-platformer video-game. That's a lot of hyphens.

Control each leg of your vessel individually with a controller, or both at the same time with the mouse!

Unlock achievements to earn colors to customize your vessel!

Master this unique control scheme and find your way home!

This game is best played with a controller, but it's definitely playable with a mouse.
